Now keep_port dispatch_keeper port_dispatch, then start_kept dispatch dispatch_keeper DISPATCH_LISTEN_FD --env 'DISPATCH_PORT={port}' --env 'DISPATCH_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:{port}' -- env -u … HOME=dispatch-home XDG_CONFIG_HOME=… "$work/envoy-dispatch", then await_start dispatch … 60 curl --max-time 5 /api/v1. write_legion_config: `port: $port_daemon` and `$(<"$work/github-apps.yaml")`, as Stage 3 writes it. worker_stream_port is gone: Stage 3 names none, and only the kubernetes runtime reads WorkerStreamPort (config.go:103, kubernetes.go:1550). The tmux runtime's worker stream is a unix socket.

start_daemon: before, pick_port port_daemon and port_worker_stream, write_legion_config and log_size, retried five times. Now start_kept daemon daemon_keeper LEGION_LISTEN_FD -- env -u LEGION_OMP_PATH -u NATS_NKEY_SEED -u NATS_NKEY_SEED_FILE -u NATS_DAEMON_NKEY_SEED -u NATS_DAEMON_NKEY_SEED_FILE -u GH_PUBLIC_REPO_PAT "${app_key_unsets[@]}" HOME OMP_PROFILE PATH=$realbin:$PATH legion start, then await_start daemon … 180 curl --max-time 5 /healthz. This is Stage 3's call. keep_port daemon_keeper port_daemon and write_legion_config run in `boot` before `legion start --check-config` (lines 588-589, where pick_port stood), as Stage 3's start_daemon runs them before its first start. Stage 3's daemon_runs_the_pinned_omp check is not added: this proof never had it, and adding it is not this round's port.
await_start: main's signature is NAME PID SECONDS DESCRIPTION COMMAND, with no log offset, so all three calls drop the offset.
